title: Flocking Time and Graph Volume in Nonlinear Cucker-Smale Models with Dynamic Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.22204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study proposes a Cucker-Smale model incorporating dynamic networks and the discrete $p$-Laplacian ($p \in (1,2)$) and analyzes the relationship between flocking time constraints and graph connectivity from both theoretical and experimental perspectives. We establish that this model achieves flocking within finite time and derive a quantitative relationship between the lower bound of flocking time and graph volume. Based on these results, we observe that imposing sufficiently small flocking time induces an increase in network volume, and that larger initial velocity variance requires greater volume under the same time constraint. In our experiments, we trained a transformer-based PPO policy to select network structures at each time step. Under the most stringent time constraint, the maximum average number of connections increased sharply, confirming a threshold effect. The negative correlation between convergence time and average n

translated_title: 动态网络非线性Cucker-Smale模型中的群集时间与图体积
translated_abstract: 本研究提出了一种融合动态网络和离散p-拉普拉斯算子（p ∈ (1,2)）的Cucker-Smale模型，并从理论和实验两个角度分析了群集时间约束与图连通性之间的关系。我们证明该模型能够在有限时间内实现群集，并推导出群集时间下界与图体积之间的定量关系。基于这些结果，我们观察到施加足够小的群集时间约束会诱导网络体积的增加，并且在相同时间约束下，较大的初始速度方差需要更大的图体积。在实验中，我们训练了基于transformer的PPO策略来在每个时间步选择网络结构。在最严格的时间约束下，最大平均连接数急剧增加，证实了阈值效应的存在。收敛时间与平均……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 本研究提出了结合动态网络与离散p-拉普拉斯算子的非线性Cucker-Smale模型，证明了其有限时间群集性并建立了群集时间下界与图体积的定量关系，同时通过基于transformer的PPO强化学习实验验证了严格时间约束下网络连接数增长的阈值效应。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a nonlinear Cucker-Smale model with dynamic networks and the discrete p-Laplacian, establishes finite-time flocking with a quantitative relationship between the flocking time lower bound and graph volume, and verifies a threshold effect in network connectivity under stringent time constraints through transformer-based PPO reinforcement learning experiments.
